title: Reject non-integer device timeouts
problem: Settings accepts True, 1.5, NaN and infinity as device_timeout_seconds, while some other non-integers raise TypeError rather than the configuration validation ValueError.
acceptance_criteria: device_timeout_seconds must have exact type int (booleans are invalid) and be positive; reject non-integers and non-positive values with ValueError.
Preserve the default 120 and all positive integer values without adding an upper limit or coercing values.
Preserve all other Settings validation, defaults, and environment behavior; add concise standard-library unittest tests.
exclusions: Only the described behavior and one new regression-test file. No dependency, UI, network, existing-test, or unrelated source changes.
